bindings.name: Provider-free fixture with an active run
bindings.value: Loop format 4: manual trigger (exposeTo ui/api/mcp) -> wait {mode: duration, seconds: 45} -> exit {outcome: success, returns: none, destinations: []}. Created by POST /loops {definition} (201 {loop, draft, issues}); started by POST /loops/{id}/runs {allowDraft: true} (202 {run}); observed by GET /runs/{id} (status waiting) and GET /loops (runCount).
bindings.consequence: Durable timers do not hold drain, so an ordinary drain completes while the run stays waiting and resumes after restart. The draining phase, and therefore open-management-observe-shutdown, is not deterministically reachable with this fixture. A script node could hold drain but would execute a command inside the gateway and is not used.

bindings.name: Health, shutdown and read routes
bindings.value: GET /healthz body exactly {"status":"ok"} with single X-GraphGoblin-Instance (64 hex), X-GraphGoblin-Pid, X-GraphGoblin-Phase. GET /system/shutdown -> {phase, graceMs, activeRunIds, unconfirmedRunIds, choices, controlToken}; POST /system/shutdown {"action":"drain"} with x-graphgoblin-shutdown-token -> 202. Local trusted mode (no key, keys not required) acts with *. Launcher maps running -> running; draining, awaiting-choice, forcing, drain-failed, force-failed -> observe-shutdown; ready, exiting, stopped -> release wait.

bindings.name: Writer leases, reclaim guards, cooperating launcher locks, store-state helper
bindings.value: Leases <D>/graphgoblin.lock and <D>/graphgoblin.db.graphgoblin.lock (private JSON with pid); guards <lease>.reclaim (directories). Launcher anchors ~/Library/Application Support/GraphGoblin/LauncherLocks/{directory,database,port}-<sha256(utf8 value)> held by flock. Read-only helper: <node> apps/api/dist/instance-identity.js [--store-state] with the gateway environment prints the 64-hex fingerprint or {"state":"free"} / {"state":"held","path","detail"}.

bindings.name: Ordinary shell start and shell-only key variable
bindings.value: Shell start: <node> apps/api/dist/main.js, cwd the checkout, with the same clean environment the driver expects of a launcher gateway (expectedEnv): HOME, PATH <nodeDir>:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin, LANG en_US.UTF-8, TMPDIR, GG_HOST=127.0.0.1, GG_PORT=P2, GG_DATA_DIR=D, GG_WEB_DIST, GG_GOBLIN_DIST, GG_DB_URL the exact byte-percent-encoded file URI of <D>/graphgoblin.db, GG_REQUIRE_API_KEY=false, GG_OLLAMA_ENABLED=false; no GG_MACOS_LAUNCHER_LOG_ADMISSION. GG_DB_URL is required: without it the API derives an unescaped 'file:' URI from GG_DATA_DIR, which for the '%41 #1' store can name a different SQLite path. Key from <D>/master.key. Shell-only key variable: GG_MASTER_KEY, used only as a synthetic launcher canary; the installer refuses it in its own environment.

bindings.name: Installer invocation, outcomes and staging
bindings.value: bash scripts/install-macos-launcher.sh realpaths itself (so a symlinked checkout saves the canonical checkout), compiles both Swift products in a private DARWIN_USER_TEMP_DIR scratch on every invocation except a lone --help, then runs the installer. Exit 0 with stdout 'GraphGoblin was installed in Applications.'; usage exit 64; other refusals exit 1 with fixed stderr text; publication failure exit 1 with 'previous installation was verified' / 'destination was verified absent' / 'Installer recovery is required'. Omitted --port defaults to 4747 and omitted --data-dir to ~/.graphgoblin, so every QA invocation passes both. Names: 'GraphGoblin ' prefix (case-sensitive) + '.app', NFC-precomposed before use; an existing entry found through the requested spelling is updated under its receipt spelling. Stage directories '.graphgoblin-launcher-stage-<32 hex>' in ~/Applications. Receipt ~/Library/Application Support/GraphGoblin/LauncherInstalls/<id>.json {version, id, name, applications, installed{bundle, executable, plist, configuration}} plus staged/stageName only while unsettled.

bindings.name: Managed logs, admission and launcher records
bindings.value: Alternate log root ~/Library/Logs/GraphGoblin/LauncherInstances/<id> (0700); gateway.log and gateway.log.1 at most 4 MiB each; launcher.log and launcher.log.1 at most 256 KiB each, 4 KiB records. Entry marker 'export const MACOS_LAUNCHER_LOG_PROTOCOL = 1;' in the first 4 KiB of main.js. Gateway receives GG_MACOS_LAUNCHER_LOG_ADMISSION={version:1, root, device, inode}. Launcher records 'stage=<stage> outcome=<code>[ child=<category>]' for non-zero outcomes other than cancelled (exit 40), unless quitting; no record for success. The product correction writes this record in a separate best-effort tail of at most 250 ms after the gateway attempt has ended, including after the unchanged 60 s admission/observation deadline, so store-blocked writes 'stage=waiting-for-store outcome=store-blocked'. The 8bddb93a preparation assumption that store-blocked writes none is historical, not current behavior.

correctionsToPriorPlan: Successful launches write no launcher.log record; G2's 'one attempt with outcome open-management-running' is not an expected observation. Failure outcomes other than cancelled write one 'stage=... outcome=...' line in a separate <=250 ms diagnostic tail, including after the 60 s deadline, so store-blocked writes 'stage=waiting-for-store outcome=store-blocked' (the 8bddb93a 'store-blocked writes none' reading is historical).
Every installer invocation except a lone --help compiles both Swift products, so O4-style refusals cost a compile each.
The installer defaults to port 4747 and ~/.graphgoblin when the flags are omitted; every QA invocation passes both.
A valid inherited LANG is passed through by design; the canary LANG must be outside the allowed character set to expect en_US.UTF-8.
The 'GraphGoblin ' prefix is case-sensitive; the case variant changes only the suffix case.
A durable wait does not hold drain; O7 becomes S4 (drain with an active run, retention, completion after restart).
Accessibility is not trusted and screen capture is unknown (preflight-02); no other UI controller is assumed.
